name: Beverungen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with four vertical stripes of white, blue, white and blue, charged at the top with the city arms of Beverungen (three white beavers on blue).
history: The city of Beverungen was granted permission to bear arms, banner, flag and seal by the Regierungspräsident in Detmold on 12 October 1972; banner and flag are white, blue, white and blue striped 1:1:1:1 with the city arms.

features.role: Beverungen arms — three beavers on blue
